name: str-14
manual: clone trs_m3 of halftrack m3 (which has m3_x) with NO trs_m3_x. In a skirmish/MP game buy both m3 and trs_m3 (roster line), destroy both: m3 swaps to its m3_x wreck/breaks apart; does trs_m3 break apart or stay a plain hulk? Needs eyes. If the clone fails to appear, check the roster line / base name via clone-entity output.
note: Stays manual: nothing destroys a vehicle over the pipe and no log names the _x swap. New verdict only proves the clone is mounted.
